text: No fires were detected on the property in the two weeks before 2026-10-04. The analysis reviewed NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, covering the entire asset boundary with multiple sensors (VIIRS and MODIS). Zero thermal detections were recorded within this period. However, note that small, short-lived, or cloud-obscured fires might not be detected. The assessment is based on satellite observations and does not confirm the complete absence of fire activity.
